vocab.endef: Asked for something in a forceful way that does not allow refusal.

vocab.endef: Petroleum, a thick liquid fuel drilled from underground and used for energy and industry .

vocab.endef: Not changed to remove rude, violent, or offensive material.

vocab.endef: Replace the original dialogue of a film or show with speech in another language.

vocab.endef: Exhaustion and loss of motivation caused by long-term stress, especially at work.
vocab.example: After months of overtime, he felt burnout and needed a real break from the job.

vocab.endef: Feeling tired and impatient because something is dull or you have nothing interesting to do.

vocab.blank: After the same routine for weeks, he said he felt _____ and wanted something new.

vocab.endef: Annoyed or unhappy because you have had too much of something unpleasant.

vocab.endef: A country in northwestern Europe, also called Holland by many English speakers.

vocab.endef: An upper limit on an amount, level, or price.
